  "body": "# Telegram Bot API

> The Bot API is an HTTP-based interface created for developers keen on building bots for Telegram.  
> To learn how to create and set up a bot, please consult our [**Introduction to Bots**](https://core.telegram.org/bots) and [**Bot FAQ**](https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq).

### Recent changes

> Subscribe to [@BotNews](https://t.me/botnews) to be the first to know about the latest updates and join the discussion in [@BotTalk](https://t.me/bottalk)

#### November 9, 2026

**Bot API 10.4**

**Widgets**

* Added the class [Widget](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#widget) and the field *widget* to the classes [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message) and [ExternalReplyInfo](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#externalreplyinfo) for messages with [HTML widgets](https://core.telegram.org/bots/widgets).
* Added the method [sendWidget](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendwidget), allowing bots to send messages with HTML widgets. Currently, in the production environment, widgets can be sent only to private chats, and sent widgets automatically have protected content and therefore can't be forwarded.
* Added the method [sendSharedWidget](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendsharedwidget), allowing bots to send again shared widgets created by the bot.
* Added the class [WidgetQuery](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#widgetquery) and the field *widget\_query* to the class [Update](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#update) for queries sent to the bot by widgets in messages sent by the bot or via the bot.
* Added the class [SharedWidgetQuery](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sharedwidgetquery) and the field *shared\_widget\_query* to the class [Update](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#update) for queries sent to the bot from forwarded messages with shared widgets.
* Added the classes [WidgetQueryType](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#widgetquerytype), [WidgetQueryTypeData](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#widgetquerytypedata), [WidgetQueryTypeSignData](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#widgetquerytypesigndata), [WidgetQueryTypeSentTransaction](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#widgetquerytypesenttransaction) and [WidgetQueryWallet](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#widgetquerywallet), describing the type of a query from a widget. A query can contain data for the bot together with the TON wallet card of the user, data signed by a TON wallet of the user, or a notification about a transaction sent from a TON wallet of the user.
* Added the method [answerWidgetQuery](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#answerwidgetquery), allowing bots to answer queries from widgets.
* Added the method [editMessageWidgetData](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editmessagewidgetdata), allowing bots to change data of a widget in a message.
* Added the method [editSharedWidgetData](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editsharedwidgetdata), allowing bots to change public data of a shared widget.
* Added the classes [InputWidgetMessageContent](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputwidgetmessagecontent) and [InputSharedWidgetMessageContent](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputsharedwidgetmessagecontent), allowing bots to send widgets in response to inline queries. Currently, widgets can't be sent in response to inline queries in the production environment.
* Widget messages can't be copied using the methods [copyMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#copymessage) and [copyMessages](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#copymessages).
* The right *can\_send\_other\_messages* in the classes [ChatPermissions](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatpermissions) and [ChatMemberRestricted](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatmemberrestricted) now also allows sending widgets.

**Ephemeral messages**

* Allowed bots to send ephemeral replies to callback queries in any chat except channel direct messages chats by specifying *callback\_query\_id* without *receiver\_user\_id* in the parameter *ephemeral\_message\_parameters* of the methods [sendMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmessage), [sendRichMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendrichmessage), [sendAnimation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendanimation), [sendAudio](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendaudio), [sendContact](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendcontact), [sendDocument](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#senddocument), [sendLivePhoto](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendlivephoto), [sendLocation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendlocation), [sendPhoto](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendphoto), [sendSticker](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendsticker), [sendVenue](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvenue), [sendVideo](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvideo), [sendVideoNote](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvideonote) and [sendVoice](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvoice).
* The field *receiver\_user\_id* of the class [EphemeralMessageParameters](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#ephemeralmessageparameters) and the parameter *chat\_id* of the mentioned methods are optional now.

**Quotes from rich messages**

* Added the field *rich\_texts* to the class [TextQuote](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#textquote) for quotes chosen from a [RichMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richmessage).
* Added the field *quote\_rich\_texts* to the class [ReplyParameters](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#replyparameters), allowing bots to quote rich messages.

**TON wallet**

* Added the classes [TonWalletCard](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#tonwalletcard), [TonWalletCardSticker](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#tonwalletcardsticker), [TonNft](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#tonnft) and [TonNftAttribute](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#tonnftattribute), and the field *ton\_wallet\_card* to the class [ChatFullInfo](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatfullinfo).
* Added the class [TonWalletTransfer](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#tonwallettransfer) and the field *ton\_wallet\_transfer* to the class [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message) for service messages about transfers with a TON wallet.
* Renamed the class StoryAreaPosition to [AreaPosition](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#areaposition), because it is now also used to describe the position of stickers on TON wallet cards.

**Chat share themes**

* Added the classes [ChatShareTheme](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatsharetheme), [ChatShareThemeEmoji](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatsharethemeemoji) and [ChatShareThemeUniqueGift](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatsharethemeuniquegift), and the field *share\_theme* to the class [ChatFullInfo](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatfullinfo), describing the theme of the screen for sharing a link to a user or a chat.
* Added the classes [EmojiType](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#emojitype), [EmojiTypeEmoji](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#emojitypeemoji) and [EmojiTypeCustomEmoji](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#emojitypecustomemoji).
* Added the classes [ChatShareThemeBackdrop](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatsharethemebackdrop) and [ChatShareThemeBackdrops](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatsharethemebackdrops) and the method [getChatShareThemeBackdrops](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getchatsharethemebackdrops).

**Gifts**

* Added the method [getUniqueGift](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#getuniquegift), allowing bots to get information about a unique gift by its name.
* Added the method [deleteBusinessAccountGift](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#deletebusinessaccountgift), allowing bots to delete regular gifts owned by a managed business account without receiving Telegram Stars for them.

**General**

* Allowed users with a Telegram Premium subscription to assign secondary usernames ending with “agent”, “ai”, “app”, “game”, or “gay” to up to 2 owned bots. Such usernames can be suggested in the field *suggested\_username* of the class [KeyboardButtonRequestManagedBot](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#keyboardbuttonrequestmanagedbot).
* Added the class [RichTextTonAddress](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richtexttonaddress) representing an address in the TON blockchain in a [RichMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richmessage).
* Added the type “ton\_address” to the class [MessageEntity](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageentity) for addresses in the TON blockchain.
* Added the type “bank\_card\_number” to the class [MessageEntity](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messageentity) for bank card numbers.
* Added the parameters *custom\_description\_parse\_mode* and *custom\_description\_entities* to the methods [verifyUser](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#verifyuser) and [verifyChat](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#verifychat).
* Added the class [PaidMessagesWaived](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#paidmessageswaived) and the field *paid\_messages\_waived* to the class [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message) for service messages about the sender using a link which allows sending messages without paying Telegram Stars.
* Added the ability to create links to topics in private chats with the bot in the format `https://t.me/<bot_username>/<message_thread_id>`. Such a link opens the topic only for the user in the private chat with whom the topic exists.

#### August 24, 2026

**Bot API 10.3**

**Rich Messages**

* Added the class [RichMessageButton](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richmessagebutton) representing a button in a [RichMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richmessage).
* Added the class [RichTextButton](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richtextbutton).
* Added the classes [RichBlockButtons](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richblockbuttons) and [InputRichBlockButtons](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockbuttons).
* Added the field *is\_compact* to the classes [RichBlockTable](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richblocktable) and [InputRichBlockTable](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblocktable).
* Added the classes [RichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richblockexpandableblockquotation) and [InputRichBlockExpandableBlockQuotation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockexpandableblockquotation) representing a block quotation, which can be expanded or collapsed back.
* Added the classes [RichBlockDocument](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#richblockdocument) and [InputRichBlockDocument](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockdocument), containing a file.
* Added support for links of the form `tg://document?id=` for general file uploads in rich messages.

**Ephemeral messages**

* Added the class [EphemeralMessageParameters](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#ephemeralmessageparameters) and replaced the parameters *receiver\_user\_id* and *callback\_query\_id* in the methods [sendMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmessage), [sendAnimation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendanimation), [sendAudio](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendaudio), [sendDocument](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#senddocument), [sendLivePhoto](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendlivephoto), [sendPhoto](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendphoto), [sendSticker](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendsticker), [sendVideo](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvideo), [sendVideoNote](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvideonote), [sendVoice](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvoice), [sendContact](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendcontact), [sendLocation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendlocation) and [sendVenue](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvenue) with the parameter *ephemeral\_message\_parameters*.
* Added the parameter *ephemeral\_message\_parameters* to the method [sendRichMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendrichmessage).
* Added the field *replace\_callback\_query\_message* to the class [EphemeralMessageParameters](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#ephemeralmessageparameters), which allows bots to show an ephemeral message in place of the original message.
* Supported upload of new files in [editEphemeralMessageMedia](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editephemeralmessagemedia).
* Added the parameter *show\_caption\_above\_media* to the method [editEphemeralMessageCaption](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editephemeralmessagecaption).
* Added the parameter *rich\_message* to the method [editEphemeralMessageText](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editephemeralmessagetext).
* Added the field *can\_send\_welcome\_messages* to the classes [ChatAdministratorRights](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatadministratorrights) and [ChatMemberAdministrator](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#chatmemberadministrator).
* Added the parameter *can\_send\_welcome\_messages* to the method [promoteChatMember](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#promotechatmember).

**Reply markup**

* Added the class [DisabledButton](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#disabledbutton) and the field *disabled* to the class [InlineKeyboardButton](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinekeyboardbutton).
* Added the field *force\_reply* to the classes [InlineKeyboardMarkup](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inlinekeyboardmarkup) and [ReplyKeyboardMarkup](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#replykeyboardmarkup).

**General**

* Added the parameters *can\_stop* and *keep\_on\_stop* to the methods [sendMessageDraft](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmessagedraft) and [sendRichMessageDraft](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendrichmessagedraft).
* Added updates about user stopping message generation, represented by the class [MessageGenerationStopped](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#messagegenerationstopped) and the field *stopped\_message\_generation* in the class [Update](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#update).
* Added the class [CommunityChatJoined](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#communitychatjoined) and the field *community\_chat\_joined* to the class [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message) for service messages about join of a chat from a community.
* Added the fields *text*, *entities* and *is\_private* to the class [UniqueGiftInfo](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#uniquegiftinfo).

#### July 14, 2026

**Bot API 10.2**

**Rich Messages**

* Added the class [InputRichMessageMedia](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichmessagemedia) and the field *media* to the class [InputRichMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichmessage), allowing bots to explicitly specify media used in *markdown* or *html* formatting when sending a rich message.
* Added the class [InputMediaVoiceNote](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputmediavoicenote), representing a voice message to be sent.
* Added the class [InputRichBlockListItem](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblocklistitem), which represents an item in a list to be sent.
* Added the classes [InputRichBlockParagraph](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockparagraph), [InputRichBlockSectionHeading](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblocksectionheading), [InputRichBlockPreformatted](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockpreformatted), [InputRichBlockFooter](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockfooter), [InputRichBlockDivider](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockdivider), [InputRichBlockMathematicalExpression](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockmathematicalexpression), [InputRichBlockAnchor](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockanchor), [InputRichBlockList](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblocklist), [InputRichBlockBlockQuotation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockblockquotation), [InputRichBlockPullQuotation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockpullquotation), [InputRichBlockCollage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockcollage), [InputRichBlockSlideshow](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockslideshow), [InputRichBlockTable](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblocktable), [InputRichBlockDetails](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockdetails), [InputRichBlockMap](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockmap), [InputRichBlockAnimation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockanimation), [InputRichBlockAudio](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockaudio), [InputRichBlockPhoto](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockphoto), [InputRichBlockVideo](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockvideo), [InputRichBlockVoiceNote](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockvoicenote) and [InputRichBlockThinking](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichblockthinking), which represent different types of blocks available to format an outgoing rich message.
* Added the field *blocks* to the class [InputRichMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#inputrichmessage), allowing bots to specify rich message formatting via block entities.

**Ephemeral Messages**

* Introduced support for [Ephemeral Messages](https://core.telegram.org/bots/features#ephemeral-messages), allowing bots to send group messages and receive commands that are visible only to a specific user and the bot.
* Added the field *is\_ephemeral* to the class [BotCommand](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#botcommand).
* Added the field *receiver\_user* to the class [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message).
* Added the field *ephemeral\_message\_id* to the class [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#message).
* Added the parameters *receiver\_user\_id* and *callback\_query\_id* to the methods [sendMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendmessage), [sendAnimation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendanimation), [sendAudio](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendaudio), [sendDocument](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#senddocument), [sendLivePhoto](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendlivephoto), [sendPhoto](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendphoto), [sendSticker](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendsticker), [sendVideo](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvideo), [sendVideoNote](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvideonote), [sendVoice](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvoice), [sendContact](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendcontact), [sendLocation](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendlocation), [sendVenue](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#sendvenue).
* Added the field *ephemeral\_message\_id* to the class [ReplyParameters](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#replyparameters), allowing bots to reply to ephemeral messages.
* Marked the field *message\_id* in the class [ReplyParameters](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#replyparameters) as optional if the field *ephemeral\_message\_id* is present.
* Added the methods [editEphemeralMessageText](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editephemeralmessagetext), [editEphemeralMessageMedia](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editephemeralmessagemedia), [editEphemeralMessageCaption](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editephemeralmessagecaption), and [editEphemeralMessageReplyMarkup](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#editephemeralmessagereplymarkup) allowing bots to edit ephemeral messages.
* Added the method [deleteEphemeralMessage](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#deleteephemeralmessage) allowing bots to delete ephemeral messages.

**Communities**

* Introduced initial support for **Communities** - several supergroups, channels, and bots linked together around a shared topic or audience.
* Added the class [Community](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#community) which represents a community.
* Added the class [CommunityChatAdded](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#communitychatadded) and the field *community\_chat\_added* to the class [Message](https://core.telegram.org/bots/ap",

{ "url": "https://core.telegram.org/bots/widgets", "title": "Telegram Widgets", "family": "bot-api", "sha": "dfc14652a3a0a6e5b8405935a78f654abd956e0eb40cafcc33eacf7f2610919c", "checked_at": "2026-11-10T18:11:20.626737+00:00", "changed_at": "2026-11-10T17:50:04.877545+00:00", "error": null, "freshness": { "stale": false, "age_seconds": 9661, "max_age_seconds": 21600, "refresh_error": null }, "body": "# Telegram Widgets Bots can send **widgets**: small interactive blocks drawn right inside a message. A widget is one self-contained HTML document with inline CSS and JavaScript, at most 32 KB of HTML and 4 KB after compression. Telegram apps run it on the user's device in a sandbox with **no network access at all**, draw it in the style of the chat, and keep it running while it is on screen: a poll whose bars move as people vote, a price ticker, a board game for two in a group, a promo code that copies on a tap. A widget is **fixed code plus changeable state**. The code, its HTML, is set when the widget is sent and never changes. What changes is the widget's state, and only the bot writes it: the **chat state**, tied to one message and seen only in that chat, and the **shared state**, seen wherever the widget is shown. The widget reads its state and redraws when it changes. It cannot change the state itself, but it can ask the bot with small requests, the way a callback button does. Widgets live in the private chat with the bot, in groups, in messages sent via the bot in inline mode, and in forwards to any chat. Currently, in the production environment, widgets work only in the private chat with the bot. The rest works on the [test server](https://core.telegram.org/bots/widgets#availability). A widget can also be a **shared widget**: one widget on the server, like a poll, that any number of messages show, with one shared state for all of them. This page is a guide to designing and implementing widgets, followed by the reference of the widget's JavaScript object `TelegramWidget`. The Bot API methods and types for widgets are in the [Bot API reference](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api). --- ### Introducing widgets #### Code and state A widget is fixed code plus changeable state. * **The code** (the HTML with its CSS and JavaScript) is set when the widget is sent and never changes, in a message or in a shared widget. No method replaces it. For a new layout, send a new widget, and old messages keep the old one. As with any media, the caption can be edited. * **The state** is what changes, and only the bot writes it. There are two kinds: + **chat state** (`chat_data`): tied to one message, seen only in that chat (shared by all members in a group), never carried by a forward. A game in progress, whose turn it is. + **shared state** (`public_data`): seen wherever the widget is shown. A static widget keeps it in the message, and a forward gets a copy as of the moment of forwarding.   "body": "#### Storage, links and haptics

**Web Storage.** `localStorage` is kept for this message on this device. It is in place from the first line of script, survives the widget being destroyed and re-created and app restarts, and is deleted with the message, the chat, the account and on “Clear cache”. It is never sent to the bot or the server and is not synced between devices: what must follow the user belongs in the chat state, which the bot writes. Each area holds 4 KB (keys and values in UTF-8). A `setItem` beyond that throws `QuotaExceededError` and stores nothing, so catch it. Keep this user's own choices there (a best score, “voted”). `sessionStorage` follows the same rules and lives until the app restarts. A forward, or another message showing the same shared widget, is another message, and its storage starts empty.

**Links.** `openLink(url)` opens an `https:` URL of at most 256 characters (no user name or password, not a `t.me`, `telegram.me` or `telegram.dog` host) after the user confirms it, shown in full. `openTelegramLink(url)` opens a `https://t.me/…` link inside Telegram without a confirmation of its own, as a tapped `t.me` link in a message does (Telegram's own handling still confirms what it always does, such as joining a chat or a proxy). Both work only in the handler of a real tap, once per tap. A tapped `<a href="https://…">` and `window.open(url)` do the same, through `openTelegramLink` for Telegram hosts and `openLink` otherwise. A URL these methods do not accept (not `https:`, too long, with a user name or password, a host of the other method, `tg:` links) throws `TypeError`. A tapped link or `window.open` with another scheme (`http:`, `javascript:`) is ignored. The widget is not told whether the user opened the link.

**Haptics.** `HapticFeedback.impactOccurred`, `notificationOccurred` and `selectionChanged` work as in Mini Apps, only while the widget is visible, at most 5 in a burst and 10 per second. They are free while a finger is down on the widget and for 5 seconds after it is lifted. Without a touch, the first call opens a one-second series and later ones are dropped. The next series may start after a touch or 10 seconds later. So a timer cannot keep buzzing the phone, while a tap, and a bot's answer that arrives a few seconds after it, can play feedback. Desktop and web apps play nothing.

**copyText.** `TelegramWidget.copyText(text)` copies 1-256 characters to the clipboard on a tap, like an inline button's `copy_text`. The app shows a toast with the copied text, so a widget cannot show one text and copy another unnoticed. `navigator.clipboard` is not available.

#### Payments with the wallet

A widget can ask the user to pay or to sign through Telegram's built-in wallet. The widget is the front of a dApp and the bot is its back end, as a site and its server are with TON Connect. The formats are TON Connect's, so a bot reuses its TON Connect code, but there is no connection, manifest or bridge: who asks is the bot that sent the message, and the app's own wallet window, outside the bubble, says so.

```
// A tap asks the bot with the user's wallet; the bot answers with a fresh transaction; the widget passes it on.
TelegramWidget.request('pay:42', { wallet: true })
  .then((a) => TelegramWidget.wallet.sendTransaction(JSON.parse(a.result), 'paid:42'))
  .then((a) => show(a.result), (e) => showError(e.code));
```
